method: Viewed original final device PNG files; no image edits
qualification: Visual sample review, not physical/child or actual TalkBack acceptance. Component captures omit the production shell; scrolled text can be clipped at the viewport boundary while strips remain fixed.

captures.name: length-5-moved-en.png
captures.observation: A is aligned and selected, B remains offset. Status correctly says A starts on the line. Left/align disabled at zero; right and Undo available.

captures.name: length-5-retry.png
captures.observation: Both equal strips align; incorrect Shorter choice remains editable with constructive retry feedback. Both strips remain fixed while controls scroll.

captures.name: length-5-solved-de.png
captures.observation: Equal aligned strips, German Help and correct equality feedback, enabled Weiter and Home visible. Pending-write frame is absent.

captures.name: length-5-complete-de.png
captures.observation: Actual production completion shell with replay, Play again, Home, four balloons and revealed clownfish after one pop.

captures.name: length-layout-a6-b6-phone-en-10-portrait-start.png
captures.observation: Equal maximum lengths retain equal pixel widths despite different starting positions; both fit the track. Unselected move and Check controls disabled.

captures.name: length-layout-a2-b2-phone-de-15-portrait-solved.png
captures.observation: Equal minimum lengths align; German 1.5x Help/feedback wrap legibly, enabled Weiter visible below. Scroll viewport clips earlier question at its boundary.

captures.name: length-layout-a6-b2-phone-de-20-landscape-solved.png
captures.observation: German 2x landscape: short B and long A fixed at left, correct shorter feedback and Weiter visible at right. Help is partly scrolled above the viewport.

captures.name: length-layout-a2-b6-phone-en-10-landscape-solved.png
captures.observation: English landscape: long B and short A align; correct longer feedback, Next and Home fit the scrolling right pane.

captures.name: length-layout-a6-b6-tablet-en-10-portrait-start.png
captures.observation: Tablet portrait uses two columns. Equal maximum strips have matching widths and distinct offsets; complete question/controls fit at right.

captures.name: length-layout-a2-b2-tablet-de-15-portrait-solved.png
captures.observation: Tablet portrait German 1.5x: equal minimum strips align; question, Help, equality feedback and Weiter visible with readable wrapping.

captures.name: length-layout-a6-b2-tablet-de-20-landscape-solved.png
captures.observation: Tablet landscape German 2x: fixed aligned unequal strips and complete shorter feedback with Weiter fit without overlap.

captures.name: length-layout-a2-b6-tablet-en-10-landscape-solved.png
captures.observation: Tablet landscape English: aligned longer B matches feedback; question, Help, Next and Home fit the right pane.
